title: Substantive createImageBitmap() rewrite

labels.name: needs tests
labels.description: Moving the issue forward requires someone to write tests

body:
There have been several cleanups already in the past couple days and this very much builds on that.

It makes it clear what is supposed to happen synchronously and what can be done "in parallel". This fixes #1553.

It makes it much more clear that img and  SVG image elements share a lot of logic with Blob objects by defining combined "rendering" steps.

It defines many more places where this algorithm can fail, primarily due to OOM conditions. Fixes #3323.

It fixes several wording issues. Fixes #3334. Fixes #3322.
